roll: {d} dives forward to the right, tucks into one fast forward somersault on the ground, rolls over his shoulder and comes straight back up onto his feet facing right. Same black jacket, empty hands.
walk_back: Back view only: {d} has his back to the camera and walks forward into the distance with steady steps, arms swinging, we see only his back, shoulders and the back of his head, continuous walk cycle on a treadmill, never turning around.
walk_front: Front view: {d} faces the camera and walks toward the viewer on a treadmill with clear steps, arms swinging at his sides, continuous walk cycle, staying in place.
walk_ur: Three-quarter back view: {d} walks diagonally away from the camera toward the upper right on a treadmill, we see his back and right shoulder, clear steps, arms swinging, continuous walk cycle, never turning to face us.
walk_dr: Three-quarter front view: {d} walks diagonally toward the camera and to the right on a treadmill, we see his face and chest turned a little to the right, clear steps, arms swinging, continuous walk cycle.
kick_front: {d} lifts his right leg and snaps a fast, hard kick forward at knee height, the leg straight out to the right in front of him, holds it a moment, then plants the foot back down. Same clothes the whole time.
punch_free: {d} keeps the stolen bag tucked under his left arm and throws a fast hard punch with his free right fist at head height, the arm snapping fully out to the right, then pulls back.
